name: nr-planar-contact-history-mismatch-draft
claim: Interaction history improves recontact response prediction for matched current observations in a spatially two-dimensional deformable body; action value is tested separately under identical feedback.
unit_of_analysis: independent complete history pair, with all future branches clustered

splits.name: id-history-holdout
splits.held_out: complete history pairs and seed ranges
splits.leakage_check: group all history members and action branches before splitting; hash trajectory lineage

splits.name: wait-command-holdout
splits.held_out: declared wait intervals and future command speeds
splits.leakage_check: freeze intervals on calibration and validation only; report interpolation separately from extrapolation

metrics.name: paired_force_effect_nrmse
metrics.rationale: Primary state-history test in the first 1.2 seconds after commanded recontact

metrics.name: full_episode_success_without_violation
metrics.rationale: Separate Gate 2 action endpoint under common feedback

ablations: same scalar sensors versus shared lateral-marker sensors
falsification_criteria: Matched observations do not exhibit a history effect above the predefined noise floor.
History paired-effect NRMSE is not below 0.5, or the improvement over snapshot is below 20%.
A classical observer matches or beats history: no neural necessity claim.
Common feedback yields less than a 5 percentage point success gain at the declared primary condition, or increases violations: no useful added action-value claim.
Mesh/time refinement changes the primary metric by more than 5% or by the intended method effect: numerical gate fails.
statistics: Cluster bootstrap over complete history pairs and optimization seeds; preserve all controller/action branches within each pair; 95% intervals.
pending_before_freeze: numerically valid geometry and strain range
